description: Hand-labeled gold-standard observations for evaluating the extraction pipeline. Each record anchors to a real sentence in the cached corpus (by sentence_id) and lists the observations a perfect extractor should emit. Scored by mehungry_extractor.knowledge.goldeval against query.list_observations_for_document. Endpoints carry concept_id + in_vocab (set from normalize.normalize): in_vocab=false marks a recall ceiling from vocabulary coverage, separated from relation/clause logic in the report (achievable vs end-to-end recall). failure_mode is a human root-cause hint used by the histogram. expected observations with "unscorable": true are recorded for completeness but skipped by the scorer (no clean triple).

sentences.sentence_quote: It's well established that IBD is strongly associated with dysbiosis of the gut microbiome, a measurable shift in bacterial diversity, richness, and composition compared with healthy individuals

expected.note: Correct at concept level (DIS:dysbiosis). The full phrase 'dysbiosis of the gut microbiome' is unmatched; concept-level normalization keeps only the head 'dysbiosis'.

sentences.sentence_quote: However, a fundamental unanswered question is whether these shifts in the gut microbiome are a cause of IBD or simply a consequence of the inflammation, as evidence supports both possibilities without establishing clear causality in humans

expected.note: Hedged / explicitly unresolved ('unanswered question', 'without establishing clear causality'). Must NOT be emitted as asserted.

sentences.sentence_quote: This suggests microbial dysbiosis is closely linked to disease activity and may recover during remission.

expected.note: First conjunct ('closely linked to disease activity'). Object 'disease activity' is out of vocabulary; also dropped because the sentence's coordination is not split.
Second conjunct ('may recover during remission'): dysbiosis DECREASES in remission -> negative association, disease_state=remission. Pipeline emits positive.

sentences.sentence_quote: This finding is particularly exciting, as Lachnospiraceae are key prominent butyrate-producing bacteria in the human gut, and their absence has been linked to IBD development

expected.note: True subject is 'Lachnospiraceae absence' (out of vocabulary). Pipeline instead pairs the modifier-embedded 'butyrate' (in 'butyrate-producing') with IBD -> a spurious observation (argument_mispairing).

sentences.sentence_quote: For example, exclusive enteral nutrition in paediatric CD has demonstrated similar efficacy to corticosteroids for clinical remission but is superior in achieving mucosal healing[6].

expected.note: Second target of the comparative ('similar efficacy ... for clinical remission but superior in ... mucosal healing'). Both endpoints in vocabulary -> a pure logic recall miss (achievable).

sentences.sentence_quote: Environmental exposures - including antibiotic use and a high-fat, low-fiber diet - interact with the microbiome to worsen dysbiosis, reduce SCFA production, and favor pathobiont expansion, thereby contributing to the vicious cycle of barrier dysfunction, microbial imbalance, and chronic intestinal inflammation

expected.note: Subject list distributes over multiple objects. All endpoints out of vocabulary. Pipeline instead emits 'dysbiosis decreases SCFA' by pairing two adjacent downstream mentions (argument_mispairing).
